resources.title: Operating System Engineering

resources.title: arXiv Computer Science
resources.notes: Research/preprint layer for computer science and software systems; individual papers require quality, version and rights verification.

known_gaps: Graduate and research software engineering needs stronger exact-cell primary literature beyond the general arXiv discovery layer.
Dedicated compiler, database, distributed-systems, security and ML-engineering curricula should be strengthened where exact taxonomy cells remain uncovered.
Expert readiness still requires runtime retrieval, build projects, testing evidence, provenance and assessment rather than catalog coverage alone.
